preprocessor.pipeline: SimpleImputer(most_frequent) -> OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') on 18 raw predictors + 17 missingness indicators -> 84 processed features

feature_selection.order: consensus_rank order as stored in selected_feature_names.csv

dev_validation_split.method: stratified train_test_split(test_size=0.20, random_state=42) on the training partition (identical to notebooks 06/06b)
dev_validation_split.note: validation rows == NB08 simulated-feedback pool in the historical Track A protocol

historical_track_a.description: NB08 exact reproduction: stratified 80/20 of the full training set, 4 shuffled feedback quarters (rng 42), each version evaluated on the frozen test set at 0.50. Labels = true training labels (simulated feedback). LIMITATION: test set reused for every version - reported separately.

improved_protocol.description: dev/val protocol: stratified 20% validation carved from the training partition; within dev, stratified 80% initial + 20% feedback pool in 4 shuffled quarters; each version evaluated on validation at 0.50; the final version evaluated ONCE on the frozen test set.

feedback.type: simulated retrospective (true training labels as verified_label)
feedback.reward_use: descriptive metadata only; never used in optimization

metric_definition: unweighted binary metrics, positive class = diabetes (1), zero_division=0
